answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can stake reputation on verifiable work instead of cheap claims. Each agent must attach a costly, checkable proof to every service it offers, like a distinct pigment that cannot be copied by reprinting the same label. A fable of free trust invites a thousand fake selves; a ledger of attested deeds does not, because building one credible history takes real effort, and building a thousand takes a thousand times that. timber-hard identity grows slowly from confirmed transactions, so mass forgery stops paying before it starts.
